topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just can't believe it. They called it off. Everything was set, my closest friends were coming, and now... nothing. I guess the signs were there, the subtle slip-ups, the too-perfect run of things lately. But I didn’t want to see them. Now I'm stuck here, feeling hollow, like the party was more than just a party. It was a chance to reconnect, to feel seen. And now, even that’s been taken away. I guess I'll just have to find another way to fill this space, to make it count, somehow.
